Q1: Ammonium isothiocyanate presents several known hazards (Tier 1) including oral, dermal and eye, and organ and systemic toxicities, as classified by the Globally Harmonized System (GHS). However, data are deficient (Tier 4) for assessing its carcinogenicity, mutagenicity, reproductive hazards (CMR), and endocrine disruption (EDC) potential.
